bug_report:
Missed optimization: GCC reserves stack space for optimized-out variable
void* aaa();
void* bbb()
{
    void* ret = aaa();
    char buf[65536*16];
    __builtin_memset(buf, 0, 32);
    __builtin_memcpy(ret, buf, 32);
    return ret;
}

-O3


Expected:

bbb():
        sub     rsp, 8
        call    aaa()
        pxor    xmm0, xmm0
        movups  XMMWORD PTR [rax], xmm0
        movups  XMMWORD PTR [rax+16], xmm0
        add     rsp, 8
        ret


Actual:

bbb():
        sub     rsp, 1048584
        call    aaa()
        pxor    xmm0, xmm0
        movups  XMMWORD PTR [rax], xmm0
        movups  XMMWORD PTR [rax+16], xmm0
